title: Rate Band Table: Renewal Value Bands for SecureRate Default Renewal Rates on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Band table for the default renewal rate of Ashgrove SecureRate contracts (Deferred Fixed Annuities). The band is chosen by the measured renewal value — the renewal value, which is the contract value at the most recent interest credit grown at the expiring guaranteed rate, as a daily equivalent of that annual effective rate, for the actual calendar days from that credit to the renewal date, rounded to the cent, taken as measured for the renewal.

## Bands

The renewal value band addition is:

| Measured renewal value | Renewal value band addition |
|---|---|
| $300000 or more | 0.30% (0.003) |
| At least $250000 but under $300000 | 0.20% (0.002) |
| At least $100000 (the high band threshold) but under $250000 | The tier's high band rate addition: 0.15% (0.0015) on every SecureRate tier |
| Under $100000 | Nothing |

The addition is made to the tier's current base rate; the default renewal rate including it is held at no less than the guaranteed minimum interest rate and rounded to four decimal places.

## Band edges (hypothetical values)

| Measured renewal value | Band addition |
|---|---|
| $300000.00 | 0.30% |
| $299999.99 | 0.20% |
| $250000.00 | 0.20% |
| $249999.99 | 0.15% |
| $100000.00 | 0.15% |
| $99999.99 | Nothing |

*Worked case (hypothetical Ashgrove SecureRate 7, current base rate 5.30%):* a measured renewal value of $310000.00 gives 5.30% plus 0.30%, that is 0.0560.
